definition: a kind of poisonous herb.
example_en: The man who consumed the poisonous herb immediately fell ill.

definition: a kind of tree.
example: ಕಾಡಿನ ನಡುವೆ ನೇೞಲ್ ಮರ ಎತ್ತರವಾಗಿ ಬೆಳೆದಿತ್ತು.

definition: (dial.) a malignant growth in the belly.
example_en: The doctor examined the malignant growth in the belly.

definition: a kind of cartilaginous marine fish; a shark.
example_en: The fishermen caught a big shark in the sea.

definition: much loved; beloved; very dear.
example_en: He remembered his very dear friend.

definition: to become modest.
example_en: The girl became modest on hearing the praise.

definition: (pl.) seventy persons.
example_en: Seventy persons had gathered at that meeting.

definition: a variety in paddy.

definition: the act of cutting, severing.
example_en: The cutting of the wood was very precise.

definition: a miss-hit with the bat, that hit the ground instead of the wooden piece tapered on both the ends.
example_en: The batsman's stroke was a miss-hit that struck the ground.

definition: that can be excused; that is eligible for being pardoned; pardonable.
example_en: The teacher said this was a pardonable mistake.

definition: a bronze drum or a big cymbal.

definition: an act of creating anew; recreation; a new creation.

definition: to have a hollow place in the stem or a branch.

example_en: The tree's trunk had become hollow, eaten by insects.

definition: a particular eye disease.
example: ಹೊಗೆಗಣ್ಣು ಬಂದ ಮೇಲೆ ಅವನ ದೃಷ್ಟಿ ಕಡಿಮೆಯಾಯಿತು.
example_en: After he contracted that eye disease, his eyesight diminished.

definition: the words of a credible or trustworthy person.
example_en: The trustworthy words of the teacher changed his mind.

definition: a kind of percussion instrument.
example_en: They were playing the kukkuru drum in the wedding procession.

definition: (dial.) insincere or dishonest talk; idle talk; gab.
example_en: Nobody believes his idle talk.

definition: a man having qualities that are regarded as characteristic of women and girls, as weakness, cowardliness, etc.; a coward.
example_en: That coward ran away from the fight.

definition: he who is bliss personified.
example: ಜ್ಞಾನಿಗಳು ಆ ದೇವರನ್ನು ಆನಂದಸ್ವರೂಪ ಎಂದು ಕರೆಯುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: The wise call that god the very embodiment of bliss.

definition: a running contest of buffaloes, in pair, held in wet, slushy rice field, prevalent in the coastal districts of Karnāṭaka.
example_en: In the coastal region, the buffalo race is very famous.

definition: an important fort that is under one's direct control.
example_en: The king guarded the important fort under his direct control tightly.

definition: the red lotus - plant Nymphaea pubescens of Nymphaeceae family.
example_en: The red lotus had blossomed and stood in the pond.

definition: a bird, akin to crow, resembling the pheasant; a crow-pheasant.
example_en: The children were delighted to see the crow-pheasant.

definition: an unbroken grain of rice.
example_en: They prepared unbroken grains of rice for the worship.

definition: a very young swan.
example_en: In the lake, the very young swan was swimming behind its mother.

definition: an inlet of a sea where ships can anchor; a harbour.
example_en: Many ships had anchored at the harbour.

definition: baked or boiled bean or corn.
example_en: The farmer ate the roasted corn in the field and rested.

definition: a woman considered in relation to her husband; a wife.
example: ಆ ರೈತ ತನ್ನ ಹೆಟ್ಟುಗೆಯೊಂದಿಗೆ ಹೊಲಕ್ಕೆ ಹೋದನು.
example_en: That farmer went to the field with his wife.

definition: an elephant driver.
example: ನಾಗಾಯ್ತ ಆನೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಕುಳಿತು ಸವಾರಿ ಮಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: The elephant driver rode sitting atop the elephant.

definition: the quality of being rustic, i.e. lack of refinement, elegance, polish or sophistication.
example: ಆ ಹುಡುಗನ ಬಟ್ಟೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಇನ್ನೂ ಗಾವಟಿ ಎದ್ದು ಕಾಣುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: That boy's clothing still clearly showed a rustic lack of polish.

definition: four times.
example: ಈ ವರ್ಷ ಬೆಳೆಯ ಇಳುವರಿ ನಾಲ್ಮೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚಾಗಿದೆ.
example_en: This year the crop yield has increased fourfold.

definition: a profession not natural or not suited.
example_en: This is an occupation not suited to him.

definition: to get or perceive the right meaning of; to know or grasp what is actually meant by.
example_en: He grasped the right meaning of the rule and answered.

definition: the human body, as a fleeting one.
example_en: The saint taught people about the fleeting nature of the human body.

definition: to keep wheezing, coughing; to be suffering from asthma.
example_en: The old man lay down wheezing and coughing.

definition: a town or village officer.
example: ಜಿಲ್ಲೆದಾರ ಊರಿನ ತಲೆ ಎತ್ತಿನ ವಿಚಾರಣೆ ನಡೆಸಿದನು.
example_en: The town officer conducted an inquiry into the village headman's case.

definition: orderliness; the state or position that is most suitable for a purpose.
example_en: They arranged all the items in an orderly manner.

definition: a knitted or woven covering for the foot usu. extending above the ankle and sometimes to the knee; a sock.
example: ಚಳಿಯಿಂದ ಕಾಲುಗಳು ನೋಯುತ್ತಿದ್ದುದರಿಂದ ಅವಳು ದಪ್ಪ ಕಾಲುಚೀಲವನ್ನು ಹಾಕಿಕೊಂಡಳು.
example_en: Because her feet were aching from the cold, she put on thick socks.

definition: a social convention or tradition followed; a custom.
example_en: The wedding took place according to this town's custom.

definition: the act or power of resisting, opposing; resistance.
example: ಶತ್ರುಗಳ ಮಲೆಹದ ಎದುರು ಸೈನಿಕರು ಗಟ್ಟಿಯಾಗಿ ನಿಂತರು.
example_en: The soldiers stood firm against the resistance of the enemies.

definition: the state or condition of being a virgin; sexual chastity of a girl or woman.
example_en: The family members respected her chastity.

definition: a town or city at the border of a territory.
example_en: The border town was famous for trade.

definition: the broad, shorter part of the intestines, comprising the caecum, colon, and rectum, that absorbs water from and eliminates the residues of digestion; the large intestine.
example_en: The large intestine absorbs water and eliminates the waste.

definition: the study and science of development of the embryo; embryology.
example_en: Medical students study embryology.

definition: a condemning (of another or something); condemnation; denunciation.
example_en: His conduct was condemned in the assembly.

definition: a moveable cupboard or ward-robe.
example_en: They brought a new moveable cupboard to keep the clothes.

definition: a kind of folk song.
example_en: At the wedding, the women sang the folk song called tarele.

definition: difficulty - a) the condition or fact of being difficult; b) something that is difficult, as a hard problem, an obstacle or objection; trouble.
example_en: The difficulty of that problem worried everyone.

definition: the extent of land owned by a person.
example_en: That landholding extended across the whole village.

definition: an awarding of a degree to a student on successful completion of a course, honorary title to a person in recognition of his or her distinguished achievement, service, etc.
example_en: The degree-awarding ceremony took place for the students at the university.

definition: to become or turn grey.
example_en: His hair turned grey with age.

definition: the act or process of mediating in settling differences between or in facilitating persons having difference of opinions; mediation.
example_en: The problem was solved through the elders' mediation.

definition: to cause, help or facilitate to become friends.
example_en: The teacher helped the two students become friends.

definition: the unpaid salary; the held-up pay.

example_en: After the administration changed, the workers were paid the held-up salary.

definition: the master or owner.
example_en: The owner of that land came from the village.

definition: that which is somewhat salty.

example_en: The farmers complained that the water of that reservoir is somewhat salty.

definition: a place where the funds of the government, of a corporation or the like are deposited, kept, and disbursed; a treasury.
example_en: There were many gold coins in the king's treasury.

definition: to make a pair of (two persons or things) by matching, joining, etc.; to pair.
example_en: The tailor paired the two pieces of cloth together.

definition: a kind of large squirrel.

definition: to devour all or anything greedily.
example_en: A hungry tiger devours its food greedily.

definition: a servant in a formal official uniform.

definition: bodily confort or pleasure.

definition: a set of two objects (of the same class); a pair.
example_en: A pair of pigeons was living in the nest.

definition: a promiscuous woman; a prostitute.
example_en: The prostitute was wandering in the street at night.

definition: a place to stand on.
example_en: He found a place to stand on the steps.

definition: a pot, pitcher having cold water.
example_en: They had kept a pot of cold water in the courtyard during summer.

definition: to increase or to become more by one hundred times.
example_en: The prices increased a hundredfold and the people suffered.

definition: fine wheat flour.
example_en: This fine wheat flour is very smooth.

definition: a cautious, wary man.

definition: a slippery, lubricous, slimy place.

definition: to weep; to lament.

definition: to become highly competent, skilled, adept or proficient.

definition: to go aside; to give way to another.

definition: a human baby; an infant.

definition: a bunch of cut flowers; a bouquet.

definition: the back or hind part; the backside.

definition: a female human being.

definition: cessation of life; death.

definition: a man who models, carves or otherwise fashions figures or forms of clay, stone, metal, wood, etc.; a sculptor.

definition: the rising sun.

definition: a volatile, crystalline ketone, C10H16O, with a strong characteristic odour, derived from the wood of the camphor tree or synthetically from pinene; camphor.

definition: a kind of insect.

definition: a written document evidencing the pledging of a valuable. House, landed property etc.
example_en: They had the pledge document for the land written up at the registration office.

definition: (dial.) a number of wagons in a string, drawn by a locomotive engine; a train.
example_en: The train departed from the station.

definition: a bruise, bruised area, as caused by whipping or a heavy blow; a weal; a welt.

definition: a man who praches the spiritual knowledge.

definition: the act, fact or an instance of tripping in walking or running; a faltering.

definition: the sport or fight of wrestlers.

definition: with marked transparency; clearly ; limpidly; absolutely.

definition: the shape, outline or configuration of anything; structure as apart from colour, material, etc.; a form.

definition: a man who plays a hand-held drum; a drummer.

definition: a reading of a passage repeatedly to commit it to memory; a conning.

definition: eating greedily or voraciously; all-devouring.

definition: smooth, fine and agreeable to the touch; not rough, harsh or coarse; soft.

definition: to emit a loud high-pitched piercing cry expressing fear, pain, extreme fright, etc.; to scream.
example_en: The injured animal screamed in pain.

definition: partly; to some extent; in part or parts; in some degree.

definition: the Supreme Being, who is present in all places at the same time; The Omnipresnt Being.

definition: a material or materials needed commonly by common people, as grains, other food items, etc. sold in a store; goods.

definition: a crowd; a group; an assemblage.

definition: a person who accompanies, associates with or shares with, another; a companion.
example_en: Without a companion, he does not do any work.

definition: frowned brows.

definition: the loss of respect, honour or esteem; an act or instance of being humiliated; humiliation; disgrace.

definition: a silicate of zirconium, ZrSiO4, a mineral found in igneous and sedimentary rocks and occurring in tetragonal crystals coloured yellow, brown, red, etc, transparent varieties of which are used as gems; zircon.
example_en: The geologist identified a crystal of zircon in the rock.

definition: a man of cobblerś caste.

definition: to display the strength of one's arm.

definition: to become dry; to lose moisture.

definition: to move with speed; to hasten oneself.

definition: the act of humidifying; humidification.

example: ಇಬ್ಬರು ಸಹೋದರರ ನಡುವೆ ಅಸಾದೃಶ್ಯತೆ ಎದ್ದು ಕಾಣುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The dissimilarity between the two brothers is clearly evident.

definition: to tie, fasten firmly with a cord, rope, chain, etc. or to tie something (as a dhōti around one's waist, etc.).
example_en: He tied the dhoti firmly around his waist.

definition: any of the varieties of acacia trees.
example_en: The wood of the acacia tree is good for the stove.

definition: a swollen part of the body; swelling.
example_en: A swelling appeared on the hand after the injury.

definition: to be low.
example_en: The ground is low on that side.

definition: a rich man.
example: ಆ ಅರ್ಥಯುತ ಊರಿನ ಶಾಲೆಗೆ ದೊಡ್ಡ ದೇಣಿಗೆ ಕೊಟ್ಟನು.
example_en: That rich man gave a large donation to the town's school.

definition: (pl.) two lines, rows (being or considered together).
example_en: They had placed lamps in both rows at the door.

definition: soft mud; soggy earth; mire; slush.
example_en: After the rain the path was full of soft mud.

definition: a small gate in a hedge or an enclosure-wall, just to allow a person to enter in; a wicket-gate.
example: ಗುಜ್ಜುತಡಮೆ ಬಾಗಿಲು ಚಿಕ್ಕದಾಗಿದ್ದರೂ ಒಬ್ಬ ಮನುಷ್ಯ ಒಳಗೆ ಹೋಗಬಹುದು.
example_en: Though the wicket-gate is small, one person can go through it.

definition: name of a country corresponding to the region of Birār, in the present Madhya Pradesh and Maharashtra in Central India.
example: ವಿದರ್ಭ ದೇಶವು ಪ್ರಾಚೀನ ಭಾರತದ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ ರಾಜ್ಯವಾಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The country of Vidarbha was a famous kingdom of ancient India.

definition: not permanent; not eternal; temporary; ephemeral.
example_en: The happiness of this world is impermanent.

definition: the state or condition of being vivacious or lively; liveliness; vivacity.
example: ಹಬ್ಬದ ಸಡಗರದಲ್ಲಿ ಮಕ್ಕಳ ಮೈಯುಬ್ಬು ಕಣ್ಣಿಗೆ ಬೀಳುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: In the excitement of the festival, the children's liveliness was plain to see.

definition: a dining plate with a hollow or hollows to hold liquid dishes; a well-dish.
example_en: They used a well-dish for the sambar in the kitchen.

definition: a sham anger or quarrel of lovers.
example_en: His beloved's sham anger endeared her to him even more.

definition: a white substance, calcium oxide, CaO, obtained by the action of heat on limestone, shells, and other material containing calcium carbonate and used in making mortar and cement; lime in loose crystal form.
example_en: They used the loose lime to whitewash the wall.

definition: a spinning wheel.
example_en: Grandmother used to spin thread using the spinning wheel.

definition: the office, manner, etc. of an administrator; administratorship.
example_en: His administratorship was a model for the whole organization.

definition: a contagious disease among cattle, sheep etc.
example_en: The farmer became anxious as a contagious disease afflicted the sheep.

definition: caused dread; frightened.
example_en: The child became frightened by the sound of thunder.

definition: the advanced stage in a person's life; old age.
example_en: In his old age his children became his support.

definition: a woody perennial plant having a single usu. elongate main stem generally with few or no branches on its lower part; a tree.
example_en: The tree swayed in the wind.

definition: Śiva, whose residence is kailāsa.
example_en: People worship the resident of Kailasa with devotion.

definition: a person who practices sorcery; a wizard; a sorcerer.
example: ಆ ಗಾಡಿಗ ಮಾಟ ಮಂತ್ರ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾನೆ ಎಂದು ಜನ ಭಯಪಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದರು.
example_en: People were afraid, saying that sorcerer practises witchcraft.

definition: a sitting together and having meals together.
example_en: On the festival day everyone sat together and had a meal.

definition: ground-nut oil.
example_en: Mother uses only groundnut oil for cooking.

definition: a sea-traveller.
example_en: That sea-traveller has toured many countries.

definition: any of several large-bodied, web-footed waterfowl with a long, graceful neck and, typically, pure white feathers known for their graceful swimming and strong flight.
example_en: A swan was swimming slowly in the lake.

definition: a small bed for an infant, usu. on rockers; a cradle.
example: ಮಗುವನ್ನು ಬಾಲಶಯ್ಯೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಮಲಗಿಸಿ ಅಮ್ಮ ಕೆಲಸಕ್ಕೆ ಹೋದಳು.
example_en: After laying the baby in the cradle, the mother went to work.

definition: a kind of agricultural implement used for weeding.
example_en: The farmer pulled out the weeds in the field with the weeding implement.

definition: a symbol, design, word, letter, etc. used by a manufacturer or dealer to distinguish a product or products from those of competitors, which is usu. registered under law.
example_en: This company's trademark is familiar to everyone.

definition: best quality ingredients used for preparing food.
example_en: The best quality ingredients were used for the festival cooking.

definition: the state or quality of being perfectly flat.
example: ಈ ಹಲಗೆಯ ಅಪ್ಪಟೆಚಪ್ಪಟೆ ನೋಡಿ ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಮೆಚ್ಚಿದರು.
example_en: Everyone admired the perfect flatness of this board.

definition: to cause frequent to & fro motion; to shake.
example: ಮಕ್ಕಳು ಮರದ ಕೊಂಬೆಯನ್ನು ಅಗಳಾಡಿಸಿ ಹಣ್ಣು ಉದುರಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: The children shook the tree branch to drop the fruits.

definition: a place where young plants are raised; a nursery.
example_en: The farmer carefully raised the saplings in the nursery.

definition: the action that gives the finished appearance; the act of beautifying.
example_en: The craftsman did the finishing work and made the house beautiful.

definition: the plant Averrhoa carambola of oxalidaceae family.
example_en: The fruit of the carambola tree is sour.

definition: the fourth day of a lunar fortnight; the fourth day following the new moon-day or full moon-day.
example_en: They celebrated the Chaturthi festival of Ganesha with devotion.

definition: the state or fact of being under another's control, restraint.
example_en: That property is now under his control.

definition: a showy or hypocritical man.
example_en: Nobody believes the words of a showy hypocrite.

definition: a cord made by interweaving thin leather straps.
example_en: The fisherman wove a cord from thin leather straps.

definition: to cease to feel angry or resentful towards; to pardon (an offender or offence); to refrain from exacting the due penalty for (an offence etc.); to excuse.
example_en: The mother pardoned the child who admitted his mistake.

definition: an acrobatic stunt performed by turning the body heels over head.
example: ಸರ್ಕಸ್ಸಿನ ಕಲಾವಿದ ಪೈಟಿ ಹೊಡೆದು ಜನರನ್ನು ಬೆರಗುಗೊಳಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: The circus artist astonished people by turning a somersault.

definition: the next life following the death in the present life.
example_en: He has no fear about the next life.

definition: stretched, extended out or over.
example_en: The plain stretched out continuously into the distance.

definition: an old owl.
example: ಆ ಮರದ ಮೇಲೆ ಒಂದು ಮುದಿಗೂಬೆ ಕುಳಿತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: An old owl was perched on that tree.

definition: a violent contention or altercation between individuals or with others; a quarrel.
example: ಎರಡು ಕುಟುಂಬಗಳ ನಡುವೆ ಜಮೀನಿನ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಕಲಹ ಉಂಟಾಯಿತು.
example_en: A quarrel arose between the two families over the land.

definition: an establishment or plant for refining or purifying crude oil or oils; an oil-refinery.
example_en: There is a large oil-refinery in this town.

definition: name of the thirty second year, in the Hindu cycle of sixty years.
example: ಪಂಚಾಂಗದ ಪ್ರಕಾರ ಈ ವರ್ಷ ವಿಳಂಬಿ ಸಂವತ್ಸರ.
example_en: According to the almanac, this year is the Viḷambi year.

definition: the act of enjoying; enjoyment.
example_en: Not everyone gets to enjoy wealth.

definition: to cause to go from one place to another; to make another wander.
example_en: He left his family and made himself wander from town to town.

definition: a medicinal plant (prob. akin to Canthium parviflorum of Rubiaceae family).
example: ಅಜ್ಜಿ ಇದುಕಾರೆ ಎಲೆಗಳನ್ನು ಕಷಾಯ ಮಾಡಿ ಕೊಟ್ಟಳು.
example_en: Grandmother made a decoction of the idukare leaves and gave it to me.

definition: a folded layer (as of a cloth, paper, etc.).
example_en: She slowly unfolded the layer of the sari.

definition: to be divided, split; to be partitioned.
example_en: The property was divided among the brothers.

definition: land or real estate owned; property.
example_en: His property was outside the village.

definition: a perceiving with one's own eye; a knowing by personal inspection.
example_en: The witness's personal, first-hand knowledge of the incident was important.

definition: the state of being a cause; causativeness.
example_en: The causative relation between fire and smoke is clear.

definition: fear; dread; alarm; panic.
example: ಸುದ್ದಿ ಕೇಳಿ ಅವಳ ಮನಸ್ಸಿನಲ್ಲಿ ವಿತ್ರಾಸ ಮೂಡಿತು.
example_en: Hearing the news, panic arose in her mind.

definition: to impress a matter in letters or pictures on a paper; to print.
example_en: The publisher printed the new book.

definition: the act or an instance of of talking.
example_en: The children's talking was very delightful to hear.

definition: an optical illusion, in which a water-body is seen, caused by the refraction of light in the hot air; a mirage.
example_en: In the desert, the mirage looked like water.

definition: to become folded or wrinkled.
example_en: The wet cloth becomes folded or wrinkled when it dries.

definition: a seller of toddy.
example_en: The toddy seller sells toddy every morning.

definition: a set of two objects (of the same class); a pair.
example_en: That pair of shoes was very comfortable.

definition: sweet talk that is capable of winning favour or cheating.
example: ವ್ಯಾಪಾರಿಯ ಪೊಗಡಿಗೆ ಮರುಳಾಗಿ ಜನ ಸಾಮಾನು ಖರೀದಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: Charmed by the merchant's flattering talk, people bought the goods.

definition: any of several large-bodied, web-footed waterfowl with a long, graceful neck and, typically, pure white feathers and which are graceful swimmers and strong fliers; a swan.
example: ಪಂಸೆ ತನ್ನ ಉದ್ದ ಕುತ್ತಿಗೆಯನ್ನು ಚಾಚಿ ನೀರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಈಜಿತು.
example_en: The swan stretched its long neck and swam in the water.

definition: a small, sensitive, erectile organ at the upper end of the vulva of a woman; the clitoris.
example_en: The structure of the clitoris was explained to the students in the lesson.

definition: a man belonging to goldsmith's caste; a goldsmith.
example_en: The goldsmith made the gold ornaments with his own hands.

definition: the strong-smelling, seedlike fruit of the annual herb Coriandrum sativum of Apiaceae family, used in flavouring food; coriander.
example_en: She added coriander to the broth and let it boil a little.

definition: a paste made using musk.
example_en: She applied musk paste to her face.

definition: to perceive or apprehend by the ear; to hear.
example: ದೂರದ ಗುಡುಗಿನ ಸದ್ದನ್ನು ಅವನು ಕಿವಿಯಾಗಿ ಕೇಳಿದನು.
example_en: He heard the sound of the distant thunder.

definition: to make a valuntary movement from one place (to another).
example_en: He set out from the town in the morning.

definition: (a children's term) to sleep.
example_en: Sleep now, we will play tomorrow morning.

definition: a kind of inferior silk.
example_en: A saree of inferior silk is available in the shop.

definition: the non-venomous snake, Tortrix cylindrophis rufus, a short tailed earth snake with a depressed rounded head not distinct from the neck and a tail very short, conical and smooth at the end.
example_en: A snake called irtaleguyya was seen in the garden.

definition: covered with awoollen cloth or blanket.
example_en: He wrapped himself in a woollen blanket to protect himself from the cold.

definition: a sect of a caste among the people of coastal districts of Karnāṭaka.
example: ಕರಾವಳಿಯ ಕುಡುಬಿ ಜನಾಂಗದವರು ವಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಸಂಪ್ರದಾಯ ಹೊಂದಿದ್ದಾರೆ.
example_en: The Kudubi community of the coastal region has distinctive traditions.

definition: the quality or condition of being fat and strong.
example: ಆ ಜಟ್ಟಿಯ ದಡೂತಿ ಎಲ್ಲರ ಗಮನ ಸೆಳೆಯಿತು.
example_en: That wrestler's stout strength drew everyone's attention.

definition: immediately; impetuously; hurriedly.
example_en: The children rushed hurriedly into the house.

definition: (the feeling of wonder) to arise.
example_en: As soon as they saw that sight, wonder arose in everyone.

definition: the tree Salix tetrasperma of Salicaceae family; country willow.
example: ಬಯಿಸೆ ಮರವು ನೀರಿನ ದಡದಲ್ಲಿ ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿ ಬೆಳೆಯುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The bayise tree grows well on the water's bank.

definition: a veil used (by women) to cover the face.
example: ಆ ಹೆಂಗಸು ಮುಖಾಡ ಹಾಕಿ ಮುಖ ಮುಚ್ಚಿಕೊಂಡಳು.
example_en: That woman covered her face with a veil.

definition: a book in which notes or memorandums, are kept; a note book.
example: ಅವಳು ತನ್ನ ನೋಟುಪುಸ್ತಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಮುಖ್ಯ ವಿಷಯಗಳನ್ನು ಬರೆದುಕೊಂಡಳು.
example_en: She wrote down the important points in her notebook.

definition: a kind of epilepsy, in which the body stiffens and bends forward.
example: ವೈದ್ಯರು ಆ ಮಗುವಿಗೆ ಮುಂಬೆಱಗು ಬಂದಿದೆ ಎಂದು ಹೇಳಿದರು.
example_en: The doctor said that child had a fit of forward-bending epilepsy.

definition: to scratch one's head with one's nails.
example_en: He scratched his head with his nails in confusion.

definition: a particular kind of arrow.
example_en: The hunter fixed the special arrow to his bow.

definition: the time when the sun changes the direction of his apparent journey at the Tropic of Capricorn (23o26' south of the celestial equator).
example_en: During the southern solstice, the sun moves southward.

definition: imitating or counterfeiting (documents, signatures, etc.).
example_en: The signature was proven to be a forgery document.

definition: a small, sensitive, erectile organ at the upper end of the vulva; the clitoris.
example: ವೈದ್ಯರು ಭಗಾಂಕುರದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಸ್ತ್ರೀರೋಗ ತಜ್ಞರಿಗೆ ವಿವರಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: The doctor explained about the clitoris to the gynaecologist.

definition: the act or an instance of swinging on a swing, in relaxing oneself or as a play.
example_en: The children were playing on the swing in the garden.

definition: a sharp chisel.
example_en: One can easily cut stone with a sharp chisel.

definition: a troubling or being troubled; trouble; vexation; dificulty.
example_en: There is much trouble from thieves on that street.

definition: to be injured or to collapse by punch or punches with another's fist.
example_en: In the fight he was punched and collapsed to the ground.

definition: the quality of wicked fellow; wickedness.
example_en: Everyone was cheated because of his cunning wickedness.

definition: the edible egg of a hen.
example_en: Mother boiled a hen's egg in the morning.

definition: a running away from (facing defeat or fearing it); a retreating.
example_en: The soldiers retreated on seeing defeat.

definition: a going away secretely and hiding from being seen or traced.
example_en: His secret disappearance worried everyone.

definition: the state or quality of being immoral.
example_en: People criticized his immorality.

definition: to raise a pandal.
example_en: They raised a pandal in the courtyard for the wedding.

definition: a mumbled or muttered complaint.
example_en: A muttered complaint escaped his mouth.

definition: a particular game of chance played with stakes.
example_en: The villagers were playing the game of chance at night.

definition: the colour of coal or pitch; black colour.
example: ಅವನ ಕೂದಲಿಗೆ ಕಾೞ್ ಬಣ್ಣ ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿ ಹೊಂದುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The black colour suits his hair well.

definition: a man who works just for earning his daily-bread.
example_en: That daily-bread worker toiled merely for his living.

definition: to have amoebic dysentry.
example_en: He got amoebic dysentery after drinking impure water.

definition: to remove or discharge from a duty, office, position or employment; to dismiss.
example_en: The manager dismissed that worker.

definition: something given to show friendship, affection, support, etc.; present; a gift.
example_en: Gifts were given to the relatives who came for the wedding.

definition: moon-light.
example: ಜ್ಯೋತ್ಸ್ನೆಯ ಬೆಳಕಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಉದ್ಯಾನ ಇನ್ನೂ ಸುಂದರವಾಗಿ ಕಾಣಿಸಿತು.
example_en: In the moonlight, the garden looked even more beautiful.

definition: that which is emaciated, lean or weak.
example_en: Due to illness his body became emaciated.

definition: the feeling excited by danger present or impending; fear; fright.
example: ಕತ್ತಲಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂಟಿಯಾಗಿ ಹೋಗಲು ಅವಳಿಗೆ ಭೀತಿ ಆಯಿತು.
example_en: She felt fear about going alone in the dark.

definition: cleverness; deftness; dexterity; ingenuity.
example_en: His cleverness astonished everyone.

definition: to dig; to sink (a pit, well, etc.).
example_en: The workers dug a well for water.

definition: any of the marks used in punctuation, as a period, comma, etc.
example_en: The proper punctuation mark should be used at the end of a sentence.

definition: to become loathsome or detestable.
example_en: The place became loathsome because of the bad smell.

definition: the tip of the penis of a horse.
example_en: The tip of the horse's penis was injured.

definition: daring or marked courage or bravery; valour.
example: ಆ ಸೈನಿಕನ ಪೆಟ್ಟುವೆರ್ಚು ಎಲ್ಲರ ಮೆಚ್ಚುಗೆ ಗಳಿಸಿತು.
example_en: That soldier's daring valor won everyone's admiration.

definition: for that reason; therefore; consequently; on account of that.
example_en: She worked very hard, therefore she won.

definition: a compelling or being compelled; coercion; constraint; compulsion.
example_en: Through compulsion they made him give up the property.

definition: a set, combination of three (things).
example: ಈ ಮೂರು ಬಣ್ಣಗಳ ಮುಕ್ಕೂಟ ತುಂಬಾ ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿ ಕಾಣುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: This combination of three colours looks very nice.

definition: to see both sides (of the same thing).
example_en: The intelligent man saw both sides of all the arguments.

definition: to instruct to do something; to give an order to; to command; to order.
example_en: The master ordered the servant to do the work.

definition: any of the luminous celestial objects seen as points of light in the sky; esp., any self-luminous, celestial body having continuous nuclear reactions which send heat, light, etc. in all directions; a star.
example_en: The stars were twinkling in the night sky.

definition: to give up; to abandon; to forsake; to leave.
example_en: He decided to give up his bad habits.

definition: a person's particular style of writing.
example_en: Her particular style of writing is easy to identify.

definition: to press together; to compress.
example: ಅವನು ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಬಟ್ಟೆಗಳನ್ನು ಒಂದೇ ಚೀಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಅಡಕಗೊಳಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: He compressed all the clothes into a single bag.

definition: a folded paper container for holding a letter, whose flap is gummed and sealed; an envelope.
example_en: She put the letter inside the envelope and sealed it.

definition: (pl.) five faces.
example_en: There was an idol with five faces in the temple.

definition: a man who robs others.
example_en: The police arrested that robber.

definition: (hist.) the department concerned with the cavalry division of the army, in the erstwhile princely state of Mysore.
example: ಮೈಸೂರು ಸಂಸ್ಥಾನದ ಬಾರ್ಗೀರ್ ಕಛೇರಿ ಅಶ್ವಸೈನ್ಯದ ಉಸ್ತುವಾರಿ ನೋಡಿಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The cavalry department of the Mysore state looked after the horse regiment.

definition: the hollow under the arm at the shoulder; the armpit; axilla.
example: ಹಳೆಗನ್ನಡ ಕಾವ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಕವುಂಕುೞ್ ಎಂಬ ಪದ ಬಳಕೆಯಾಗಿದೆ.
example_en: The word 'kavuṅkuḷ', meaning armpit, is used in old Kannada poetry.

definition: a viewing of the cavities of internal organs of a person or of pearls, using an endoscope; endoscopy.
example: ವೈದ್ಯರು ಅಂತರ್ದರ್ಶನ ಮಾಡಿ ಹೊಟ್ಟೆಯ ಒಳಗನ್ನು ಪರೀಕ್ಷಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: The doctor performed an endoscopy and examined the inside of the stomach.

definition: a face that is expressing wrath, displeasure, etc.
example: ಸೋಲಿನ ಸುದ್ದಿ ಕೇಳಿ ಅವನ ಮುಖದಲ್ಲಿ ಹೊಗೆಮೊಗ ಮೂಡಿತು.
example_en: Hearing the news of the defeat, a wrathful face appeared on him.

definition: to pass into or through as a pointed instrument does; penetrate; stab; to pierce.
example_en: The needle pierced his finger.

definition: a bearer of a burden.
example: ಆ ದೂವಾರಿ ಭಾರೀ ಚೀಲಗಳನ್ನು ಹೊತ್ತು ಸಾಗಿದನು.
example_en: That burden-bearer carried heavy sacks and went along.

definition: the state of being student (esp. studying religious subjects, before being married).
example: ಹಿಂದಿನ ಕಾಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಚರ್ಯ ಒಂದು ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಆಶ್ರಮವಾಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: In olden times, the student stage of life was an important phase.

definition: the act or an instance of cutting off another's head; decapitation.
example_en: By the king's order the thief's decapitation took place.

definition: a kind of balsam tree (?).
example_en: Balsam trees have grown in the forest.

definition: of or belonging to beasts; animal; brutal.
example_en: His brutal behaviour frightened everyone.

definition: a place for entering; a gateway; a doorway; an entrance.
example_en: The temple's entrance gateway is very beautiful.

definition: any of malacostracan crustaceans of Amphipoda order, with a vertically thin body and one set of legs for jumping or walking and another set for swimming, as the sand hopper; an amphipod.
example_en: An amphipod is jumping about in the sand on the seashore.

definition: the hard joint of the stem of a plant (as of jowar, sugarcane, bamboo, etc.).
example_en: The joint of the bamboo is very hard.

definition: a tall tree, with weak wood, Agati grandiflora (=A.sesbania, = Sesbania grandiflora) of Leguminosae family; Sesbana.
example: ಮನೆಯ ಮುಂದೆ ಒಂದು ಎತ್ತರವಾದ ಅಗಸೆ ಮರವಿತ್ತು.
example_en: There was a tall sesbania tree in front of the house.

definition: a lightning; - a) a flash of light in the sky caused by the discharge of atmospheric electricity from one cloud to another or between a cloud and the earth; b) such a discharge of electricity.
example_en: Lightning flashed brightly in the sky.

definition: the plant a) Aloe barbadensis (= A. Vera) of Liliaceae family.
example_en: She applied the juice of the aloe to her face.

definition: the branch of mathematics that deals with the deduction of the properties, measurement, and relationships of points, lines, angles, planes, and figures and their mutual relations in space; geometry.
example_en: He learned geometry with interest at school.

definition: fearful uncertainty, anxiety, etc.; apprehension; trepidation.
example: ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯ ಫಲಿತಾಂಶಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಅವಳಿಗೆ ತೀವ್ರ ಕಾತಳ ಉಂಟಾಯಿತು.
example_en: She felt intense anxiety while waiting for the exam results.

definition: a charming smile.
example_en: The child's charming smile won everyone's heart.

definition: the state of being a woman; womanhood.
example_en: She upheld womanhood with pride.

definition: any of the vowels.
example: ಕನ್ನಡ ವರ್ಣಮಾಲೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅ, ಆ ಮುಂತಾದವು ಮಾತೃಕಾಕ್ಷರಗಳು.
example_en: In the Kannada alphabet, a, aa and the like are vowels.

definition: the place of one's living.
example_en: The wayfarers set up a dwelling at the foot of the hill.

definition: free, unoccupied time during which a person may indulge in rest, recreation, etc.; leisure.
example_en: One gets leisure during the holidays.

definition: a man having feminine characters; a womanish man.
example_en: That womanish man found men's work difficult.

definition: the quality of being humble; humility.
example_en: That teacher's humility attracted everyone.

definition: a female human being.
example_en: That woman was a teacher at the school.

definition: the act of communicating through spoken words.
example_en: The teacher's spoken communication was clearly understood by the students.

definition: a sudden, sharp physical or emotional pain; a spasm of distress.
example: ಸುದ್ದಿ ಕೇಳಿ ಅವಳ ಎದೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಇಱಿನೋವು ಉಂಟಾಯಿತು.
example_en: Hearing the news, a sharp pang of pain arose in her chest.

definition: a loud shout; an outcry.
example_en: The children's loud shout was heard throughout the house.

definition: to cause to receive or accept; to hand over.
example_en: She handed over the gift to her mother.

definition: with a sharp, shrilling sound; screamingly.
example_en: The door shut with a sharp sound.

definition: to stretch one's hand.
example_en: When help was needed, he stretched out his hand.

definition: pasta made of wheat flour in the form of long, thin strings, cooked by boiling or steaming and served with a sauce; spaghetti.
example_en: She cooked spaghetti in milk.

definition: physical training as in a gymnasium.
example_en: The wrestler used to do physical training in the gymnasium every day.

definition: the gourd-pipe of jugglers and snake charmers.
example_en: The snake charmer blew the gourd-pipe and made the snake dance.

definition: the quality of being tasteless; tastelessness.
example: ಈ ಅನ್ನದಲ್ಲಿ ಸಪ್ಪೆ ಇದೆ, ಉಪ್ಪು ಸಾಕಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: There is tastelessness in this rice; there is not enough salt.

definition: the state or fact of being intimate; intimate association.
example_en: Intimate closeness had grown between them over the years.

definition: diminished; weakened; grown less in number, extent or degree.
example_en: His pain was diminished by the medicine.

definition: a kind of undercoat or jacket worn by men.
example_en: The farmer wore an undercoat because of the cold.

definition: (used as sing.) a god.
example_en: People worshipped the god in the temple.

definition: a hemispherical roof or one formed by a series of rounded arches or vaults on a round or many-sided base; a large cupola; a dome.
example: ಆ ಪುರಾತನ ಗುಂಬಜು ಈಗಲೂ ಪ್ರವಾಸಿಗರನ್ನು ಆಕರ್ಷಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: That ancient dome still attracts tourists.

definition: without use; uselessly; fruitlessly; futilely.
example_en: She shouted uselessly and then fell silent.

definition: the beginning of a new era.
example_en: On Yugadi people celebrate the beginning of the new year.

definition: a thick mixture of clay, and sometimes sand, with water, that is impervious to water.
example_en: Mire covered the whole path, making it hard to walk.

definition: the tendency of talking too much; talkativeness.
example_en: Her talkativeness irritated everyone in the meeting.

definition: to overpower or dim the vision of with very bright light or moving lights; to dazzle.
example_en: The light of the firecrackers dazzled the children's eyes.

definition: of different colours; variegated.
example_en: Variegated flowers bloomed in the garden.

definition: swiftly and recklessly; rashly.
example_en: The boy ran swiftly and recklessly and fell down.

definition: the annual, tendril-climbing plant Pisum arvense of Papilionaceae family.
example_en: The farmer grew the pea crop in the field.

definition: a mouthful of food; a small, round lump or mass of; a bolus.
example: ಅಜ್ಜಿ ಒಂದು ಕವಳ ಅನ್ನವನ್ನು ಬಾಯಿಗೆ ಹಾಕಿದಳು.
example_en: The grandmother put a mouthful of rice into her mouth.

definition: study of the molecules of the substances involved in the process of life; molecular biology.
example_en: He is studying molecular biology at the university.

definition: toward the back or rear; backward.
example_en: He walked backward.

definition: (rice) to boil with bubbling from excess heat.
example_en: The rice kept on the stove was boiling with bubbling from excess heat.

definition: to make (something) clear, evident.
example_en: The teacher made the subject clear and evident.

definition: to see personally.
example_en: He saw the incident personally with his own eyes.

definition: not blinking (the eye-lids).
example_en: Her gaze, unblinking, kept looking at the picture.

definition: the small-sized, evergreen tree Anacardium orientle ( = Semecarpus anacardium) (Aof Anacardiaceae family; cashew tree.
example_en: Oil is extracted from the seeds of the marking nut tree.

definition: to win - a) to gain a victory; be victorious; to triumph; b) to finish in first place in a race, contest, competition, game, etc.; c) to gain or acquire through accomplishment (as prize, distinctions, honour, love, etc.); d) to get a favourable verdict (in a court of law or people in an election, etc.).
example_en: He worked very hard to win the competition.

definition: a person who lacks courage in facing danger, difficulty, opposition, pain, etc.; a timid or easily intimidated person; a coward.
example_en: That coward got frightened even by a small sound.

definition: a pandal raised all along the road.
example_en: They have raised a pandal along the road for the wedding.

definition: a great quantity or store of money, valuable possessions, property or other riches; wealth.
example_en: He possessed immense wealth.

definition: the practical work of a surveyor, collector of scientific data, sociologist, etc., conducted in the natural environment rather than a laboratory, office, etc.; field-work.
example_en: The scientists conducted field-work in the forest.

definition: the colour of the spark; the bright red colour.
example_en: The spark-red colour of that gem was very attractive.

definition: roughness of a surface.
example_en: The roughness of the stone's surface pricked the hand.

definition: a slimy and sticky vegetable substance used as soap.
example_en: Grandmother used the sticky vegetable soap substance to wash clothes.
